description:
The food.gdt dataset is loaded in Gretl (40 households, variables 'food_exp' and 'income'). Your goal is to perform a Weighted Least Squares (WLS) regression to correct for heteroskedasticity.

1. Create a new variable named 'wt' defined as '1/income'. You can do this via 'Add > Define new variable' or the console.
2. Run a WLS regression of 'food_exp' on 'const' and 'income', using 'wt' as the weight variable. (Menu: Model > Other linear models > Weighted Least Squares, or command 'wls wt ; food_exp const income').
3. Save the complete regression output text to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/wls_results.txt'.
